title: Let the family-mapping flag stand in for the relationship view scope
body:
Companies without the relationships package can use asset relationships once `relationships.family_mapping` is on for them. The flag stands in for `entity:view_relationships` only, never for `entity:manage_relationships`.

| Access | Before | After |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Read (types, list) | view scope | view scope **or** flag |
| Write (create, destroy) | view scope **and** manage scope | (view scope **or** flag) **and** manage scope |

Tests cover reads with the flag and that the flag alone can't create.

commits.messageHeadline: Let the family-mapping flag stand in for the relationship view scope
